summary: Ovation is an AI-first guest-experience platform for restaurants built around a two-question, SMS-based feedback survey (usable on- and off-premise via integrations, QR codes, and phone numbers) that routes happy guests to public reviews and unhappy guests into a private real-time resolution conversation with the restaurant's team.

Ovation raised a $2 million Series A round (led by TIA Ventures, with participation from former Blaze Pizza CEO Jim Mizes and former Native Foods CEO Carin Stutz) bringing total funding to $9 million, and separately raised $3 million entirely from its own restaurant customers. (Scope note: Two distinct raises are referenced (the $2M Series A bringing total to $9M, and a separate $3M customer-funded round); exact chronological order and dates were not fully disambiguated in available sources.)
Restaurant chains including Big Chicken, Mooyah, and Friendly's use Ovation's guest-feedback platform.
The Ovation Guest Feedback iOS app had a 4.6/5 App Store rating from 11 ratings at access.
